WITH RECURSIVE organization_path AS ( SELECT equipment.id AS equipment_id, organization.id AS organization_id, organization.parent_id, organization.organization_code, organization.organization_name, organization.organization_type FROM equipment JOIN organization ON organization.tenant_id = equipment.tenant_id AND organization.id = equipment.organization_id AND organization.deleted = 0 WHERE equipment.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND equipment.deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT child.equipment_id, parent.id, parent.parent_id, parent.organization_code, parent.organization_name, parent.organization_type FROM organization_path child JOIN organization parent ON parent.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND parent.id = child.parent_id AND parent.deleted = 0 ) SELECT CASE WHEN #{rankingType} = 'EQUIPMENT' THEN e.id ELSE path.organization_id END AS scope_id, CASE WHEN #{rankingType} = 'EQUIPMENT' THEN e.equipment_code ELSE path.organization_code END AS scope_code, CASE WHEN #{rankingType} = 'EQUIPMENT' THEN e.equipment_name ELSE path.organization_name END AS scope_name, CASE WHEN #{rankingType} = 'EQUIPMENT' THEN 'EQUIPMENT' ELSE path.organization_type END AS scope_type, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(r.run_time_minutes) / NULLIF(SUM(r.loading_time_minutes), 0), 6), 0) AS availability_rate, COALESCE(CASE WHEN #{capPerformance} THEN LEAST(ROUND( SUM(r.standard_cycle_seconds * r.actual_quantity / 60) / NULLIF(SUM(r.run_time_minutes), 0), 6), 1) ELSE ROUND( SUM(r.standard_cycle_seconds * r.actual_quantity / 60) / NULLIF(SUM(r.run_time_minutes), 0), 6) END, 0) AS performance_rate, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(r.good_quantity) / NULLIF(SUM(r.actual_quantity), 0), 6), 0) AS quality_rate, COALESCE(ROUND( (SUM(r.run_time_minutes) / NULLIF(SUM(r.loading_time_minutes), 0)) * CASE WHEN #{capPerformance} THEN LEAST( SUM(r.standard_cycle_seconds * r.actual_quantity / 60) / NULLIF(SUM(r.run_time_minutes), 0), 1) ELSE SUM(r.standard_cycle_seconds * r.actual_quantity / 60) / NULLIF(SUM(r.run_time_minutes), 0) END * (SUM(r.good_quantity) / NULLIF(SUM(r.actual_quantity), 0)), 6), 0) AS oee_rate, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(r.target_oee_rate), 6), 0) AS target_oee_rate, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM equipment_oee_record r JOIN equipment e ON e.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND e.id = r.equipment_id AND e.deleted = 0 JOIN organization_path path ON path.equipment_id = r.equipment_id AND ( (#{rankingType} = 'EQUIPMENT' AND path.organization_id = r.organization_id) OR (#{rankingType} != 'EQUIPMENT' AND path.organization_type = #{rankingType}) ) WHERE GROUP BY scope_id, scope_code, scope_name, scope_type ORDER BY oee_rate DESC, scope_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT d.loss_reason_id, reason.reason_code, reason.reason_name, reason.loss_category, reason.affects_metric, SUM(d.duration_minutes) AS duration_minutes, COALESCE(ROUND( SUM(d.duration_minutes) / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(d.duration_minutes)) OVER (), 0), 6 ), 0) AS proportion, COUNT(*) AS occurrence_count FROM equipment_downtime_record d JOIN equipment e ON e.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND e.id = d.equipment_id AND e.deleted = 0 JOIN equipment_oee_record r ON r.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND r.equipment_id = d.equipment_id AND r.production_date = d.production_date AND r.shift_id = d.shift_id AND r.data_status IN ('APPROVED', 'LOCKED') AND r.deleted = 0 JOIN equipment_loss_reason reason ON reason.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND reason.id = d.loss_reason_id AND reason.deleted = 0 WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.deleted = 0 AND d.production_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND
AND d.organization_id IN
#{selectedOrganizationId}
AND d.equipment_id = #{equipmentId} GROUP BY d.loss_reason_id, reason.reason_code, reason.reason_name, reason.loss_category, reason.affects_metric ORDER BY duration_minutes DESC, d.loss_reason_id
